other_conditions: Enterprises must have been in continuous production for the previous three years.
Enterprises must have valid statutory clearances and licenses as applicable.
An enterprise can receive only one award in each category during the scheme’s operative period.
Awards are available for women entrepreneurs.
Awards are available for first‑generation entrepreneurs below 35 years of age.
Separate awards exist for SC and ST entrepreneurs.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹2,00,000 along with a trophy and appreciation letter for each winner across Micro, Small, Medium enterprises and for women, young, SC and ST entrepreneurs as well as successful start‑ups.
